      calc
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (q.num : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ) * (q.den : ℝ)) := by
          field_simp [q.den_nz]
          ring_nf
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ))) ^ (q.den : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (q : ℝ)) ^ (q.den : ℝ) := by
          have h_q_eq : (q.num : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) := by

            <;> norm_cast
            <;> simp [Rat.den_nz]

    have h_num_nat : q.num.toNat = q.num.toNat := rfl
    have h_num_pos_nat : 0 < q.num.toNat := by
      have h_num_pos_int : 0 < q.num := h_num_pos
      have h_toNat_pos : 0 < q.num.toNat := by

        exact h_num_pos_int

      have h_cast : (2 : ℝ) ^ (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = (9 : ℝ) ^ (q.den : ℝ) := by
        calc
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (q.num : ℝ) := by
            have h_cast_num : (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = (q.num : ℝ) := by

              <;> norm_cast
            rw [h_cast_num]
          _ = (9 : ℝ) ^ (q.den : ℝ) := h_2_pow_num
          
      norm_cast at h_cast
      <;> simp_all [Int.cast_pow]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> linarith
      
    -- Divisibility argument
    have h_dvd : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (9 : ℤ) ^ q.den := by
      rw [h_int_eq]
      exact dvd_pow_self 2 (by
        have h_den_pos : 0 < q.den := by exact_mod_cast q.den_pos
        omega)
      
    have h_not_dvd : ¬ (2 : ℤ) ∣ (9 : ℤ) ^ q.den := by
      intro h_dvd
      have h_prime_2 : Prime (2 : ℤ) := by apply Int.prime_two

    rw [h_ab_val]
    intro h_irrat
